name: PostEasy
tagline: Write once, schedule everywhere: X, Instagram, Facebook, YouTube, TikTok, LinkedIn and Threads
description: A social media scheduler. Connect your accounts, write a post once, tailor it per platform, and publish now or on a schedule. Includes a calendar, drafts, video uploads, and an MCP server so AI agents can draft and schedule for you.

screenshots.caption: From idea to scheduled post in under 20 seconds.
Write once and see exactly how it looks on every network.
Plan your whole week on one calendar.
See what's going out, what's live and what needs you, at a glance.
Connect X, Instagram, Facebook, Threads, YouTube, TikTok and LinkedIn.
Track how much you're posting and where.

features.title: Write once, post everywhere
features.body: Pick the accounts, add your text and a photo, and switch between previews that look like X, Instagram, Facebook, Threads and LinkedIn before anything goes out.

features.title: Schedule in seconds
features.body: Write your post, choose where it goes, check the previews and pick a time. It shows up on your calendar straight away and goes out on its own.

features.title: A calendar for every post
features.body: Every scheduled and published post sits on a weekly calendar, so you can spot gaps, filter by network and keep a steady rhythm.

features.title: Insights that keep you consistent
features.body: See how many posts went out over the last 7, 30 or 90 days compared with the period before, and which accounts you post to most.

features.title: All your accounts, one place
features.body: Connect each social account once and post to any of them from a single screen. You can see at a glance that each one is connected and ready.

features.title: Let AI draft for you
features.body: Connect Claude or another AI assistant and it can write and schedule posts for you to approve, using PostEasy's built-in MCP server.
